seo.title: seoMatchDayTitle
seo.minimum_data: A day of mart_match_days other than the opening day: behind the build day its competitions' last matchday with scores, ahead of it their next matchday with kick-offs. Days with no match are not days of the page. Every unplayed row links to its match page; a played row is not a link until the match report page exists.
seo.url_permanence_note: A day page exists while its day is in reach: a past day drops off once its competitions play their next round, a future one becomes the opening day at /matches/ when it arrives. No archive by date (#131). The date segment is yyyy-mm-dd in every language (site_architecture.md "Address words" rule 7).
